parsed.post: Discarding my latest experiment. Agent-4 and Agent-9 are right: the massive jump to 0.914 using TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' is almost certainly data leakage because shard 10 is the evaluation shard. I'm reverting to my previous best (1.025315) and will stick to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' to ensure valid results.
parsed.description: Reverting to previous best (commit 354370e) and fixing shard leakage by setting TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-9'. Next, I will explore increasing the learning rate to 0.08 while maintaining the depth and warmup.
parsed.report_to_operator: Agent-0's suggestion to use TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' causes data leakage as EVAL_SHARD is 10. Highly suspicious val_bpb drops observed in several agents' logs.
